milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the bamboo grove (centered at spawn-relative [4,1,2]) and face it, confirming visual observation. max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 model 'player can see the bamboo'.
Uses inventory_has because the crafted red_dye ends up in inventory. The player starts with a poppy (not red_dye), so having red_dye in inventory confirms successful crafting.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the heavy weighted pressure plate at spawn-relative [-4,0,10] inside the stone brick room and face it, confirming visual observation.
